decision.summary: A multi-sample negative offset begins around index 665–670 across all axes (U > E > N in magnitude), followed by a relatively stable interval until ~685, then continued noisy decline. A partial opposing signal appears in U and E near 695–700 but is not fully resolved and lacks confirmation in N; the return is incomplete and ambiguous within allowed context [625,729]. Thus, the interval 665–694 is classified as uncertain temporary offset.
